title: tetradenia gilva
intro: Tetradenia gilva, commonly known as 'Yellow Fever Plant', is a medicinal plant species native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Tetradenia gilva include reducing fever, relieving pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Tetradenia gilva contribute to its medicinal properties, providing a natural remedy for various health issues.
